scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ogm/web run build:deps && tsc -b && node scripts/build-shell.mjs && node scripts/build-app-capture.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scenarios/tsconfig.json && tsc -p shell/tsconfig.json && tsc -p app-capture/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @ogm/contracts --filter @ogm/room-protocol build && pnpm build && node scripts/emit-schema.mjs --check
scripts.scenario: pnpm --filter @ogm/contracts --filter @ogm/config --filter @ogm/room-protocol --filter @ogm/iframe-bridge --filter @gm/host --filter @ogm/design-log --filter @gm/sdk --filter @ogm/rooms build && pnpm build && node scenarios/scenario.ts
